C) That said,
D) Consequently,

While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

- In a 2021 study, researchers showed participants sets of images.
- Each set contained an unaltered image of a different character or logo alongside two slightly altered versions.
- Participants were asked to identify the correct version in each set.
- In the set containing the Monopoly Man, 26.5% of participants selected the correct version, and 73.5% selected an altered version.
- In the set containing the Target logo, 63.6% of participants selected the correct version, and 36.4% selected an altered version.

The student wants to explain how participants performed on the set with the Target logo. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

A) The Monopoly Man and the Target logo were both included in a 2021 study.
B) While 63.6% of participants selected the correct version of the Target logo, just 26.5% selected the correct version of the Monopoly Man.
C) In a 2021 study, researchers showed participants sets of images containing unaltered versions of popular characters or logos, such as the Target logo, alongside two altered versions.
D) When shown an image set of the Target logo, 63.6% of participants identified the correct version, and 36.4% selected an altered version.

While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

- The typical resting viscosity of oobleck (cornstarch mixed with water) is 5-100 centipoise (cP).
- Oobleck increases in viscosity (becomes thicker) when shaken.
- The typical resting viscosity of ketchup is 50,000-70,000 (cP).
- Ketchup decreases in viscosity (becomes thinner) when shaken.
- A fluid is Newtonian if its viscosity remains stable under shear (mechanical force such as being shaken or stirred).
- A fluid is non-Newtonian if its viscosity changes under shear.

The student wants to contrast how shear affects ketchup and oobleck. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

A) Ketchup is non-Newtonian, meaning its viscosity decreases under shear; oobleck, by contrast, increases in viscosity.
B) Though the viscosities of both oobleck and ketchup change under shear, oobleck's typical resting viscosity (5-100 cP) is lower than that of ketchup (50,000-70,000 cP).
C) Ketchup becomes thinner when shaken, while oobleck becomes thicker.
D) Oobleck has a much lower resting viscosity than ketchup but becomes thicker under shear.
